thought.text: Connection restored. Let me check the final state of all components:

reasoning_content: The connection has been restored. Next, I'll check the status of boards and the full final state.

action.command:
echo "=== containers ==="; docker ps --format '{{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}' | head -12
echo "=== dev servers ==="
for p in 38489 45423 43781; do curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 5 -w "$p: %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:$p/ 2>/dev/null || echo "$p: closed"; done
echo "=== through proxy ==="
for h in app.workspace.localhost cms.workspace.localhost boards.workspace.localhost; do
  code=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null --max-time 10 -w "%{http_code}" "http://127.0.0.1:80/" -H "Host: $h" 2>/dev/null)
  echo "$h -> $code"
done
free -m | sed -n '2p'
